description.value: BC Liquor Store (BCLIQUOR) is a provincial government-operated retail liquor store, one of 198 locations across British Columbia. The Hillside store in Victoria carries wine, spirits, beer, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic products. It is a convenient stop for touring cyclists looking to resupply on beverages along the Hillside Avenue corridor.
